en.Unsigned value: An integer value with no negative range; arithmetic uses a defined modulus.
en.Undefined behavior: A case for which the C standard imposes no behavior requirements.
en.Invariant: A fact preserved at a chosen program boundary.
en.Pointee: The live object designated by a pointer.
en.One-past pointer: A valid array boundary marker that must not be dereferenced.
en.Pointer to row: A pointer whose pointed-to type is a whole row array.
en.Null terminator: The zero character marking the end of a C string.
en.Capacity: The total number of bytes available in a destination buffer.
en.End pointer: A pointer returned by conversion to the first unconsumed character.
en.Member: A named component stored within a structure or union.
en.Padding: Storage bytes inserted by an implementation to satisfy layout requirements.
en.Tagged union: Shared member storage paired with a tag that identifies the intended representation.
en.Stream: A C library object that manages buffered input or output.
en.EOF: A special input result distinct from all unsigned-char values.
en.Complete element: One full element of the size requested from fread or fwrite.
en.Owner: The code responsible for releasing an allocation exactly once.
en.Borrower: Code allowed to use an object while its lifetime and contract remain valid.
en.Dangling pointer: A pointer associated with an object whose lifetime has ended.
en.Head link: The pointer variable that identifies the first node or NULL.
en.Splice: Changing a fixed number of links to insert or remove nodes at a known position.
en.Pointer to pointer: A pointer used to reach and update another pointer variable.
en.Callback: A function passed as behavior for another operation to invoke.
en.Function pointer: A typed pointer used to designate and call a compatible function.
en.Comparator: A callback reporting negative, zero or positive according to an ordering.
en.Macro expansion: Replacement of preprocessing tokens before ordinary C type checking.
en.Translation unit: The source remaining after a source file and its included text are preprocessed.
en.Multiple evaluation: Evaluating an argument expression more than once because its tokens were duplicated.
en.Declaration: A statement introducing an identifier and its type to the compiler.
en.Definition: A declaration that also supplies an object or function implementation.
en.Linkage: The rule determining whether declarations denote the same entity across scopes or translation units.
en.Handler: A function entered when a caught signal is delivered.
en.Signal mask: The set of signals whose delivery is currently blocked.
en.Async-signal-safe: Permitted by the signal contract even if an interrupted operation was in progress.
en.Process: An execution context with an address space and operating-system resources.
en.Fork result: Zero in the child, the child PID in the parent, or minus one on failure.
en.Copy-on-write: An implementation technique that delays physical copying while preserving separate ordinary memory semantics.
en.Program image: The code and ordinary data replaced by a successful exec.
en.Reaping: Collecting a terminated child’s status with a wait operation.
en.Encoded status: The wait result interpreted through macros rather than as a raw exit code.
en.Endpoint: A descriptor used for the read or write side of a pipe.
en.Framing: An application rule for reconstructing records from a byte stream.
en.Partial transfer: A successful transfer of fewer bytes than requested.
en.Message type: A positive long used by a System V queue to categorize or select messages.
en.Datagram: A bounded message whose boundary is preserved by the transport.
en.Socket pair: Two connected local endpoints created together for communication.
en.Shared segment: Storage attached to multiple processes as the same underlying bytes.
en.Permit: One unit of availability consumed by a successful semaphore wait.
en.Quiescent point: A point where no participant holds a partly completed reservation or update.
en.Start routine: A function with signature void *worker(void *) used by pthread_create.
en.Join: An operation that waits for a joinable thread to finish and collects its result.
en.Ownership transfer: An explicit change in which code must eventually release an object.
en.Data race: Unordered conflicting accesses across threads, with at least one non-atomic access.
en.Critical section: The code region executed while holding the lock protecting its invariant.
en.Atomic transaction: A whole logical operation that other participants cannot observe halfway through.
en.Reentrancy: The ability to enter an operation again without corrupting hidden unfinished state under its stated contract.
en.Reader–writer lock: A lock allowing multiple readers or one exclusive writer.
en.Snapshot: An independent copy whose lifetime is defined after protected access ends.
en.Predicate: The persistent shared fact that determines whether progress is permitted.
en.Spurious wakeup: A return from waiting that does not establish that the predicate is true.
en.Broadcast: A notification making all current waiters eligible to resume and recheck.
en.Circular wait: A dependency chain in which each participant waits for another and the chain returns to its start.
en.Lock rank: A stable ordering key used to acquire multiple locks consistently.
en.Livelock: Repeated activity that does not complete useful work.
en.Speedup: Serial elapsed time divided by parallel elapsed time for equivalent work.
en.Span: The longest dependency chain in a computation.
en.Overhead: Work introduced by coordination, scheduling or data movement rather than the original useful task.
en.Partition: A division of work into owned subproblems with clear boundaries.
en.Reduction: Combining local results with a specified operation and grouping.
en.Prefix scan: Computing the cumulative result up to each input position.
en.Minimal reproduction: A small case preserving the conditions needed to reveal a failure.
en.Fault injection: Deliberately making a selected operation fail to test its recovery contract.
en.Regression check: A retained check that detects the return of a previously understood defect.

zh.无符号值: 不含负数范围的整数值，其算术使用规定模数。
zh.未定义行为: C 标准不规定行为要求的情况。
zh.不变式: 在选定程序边界始终保持的事实。
zh.所指对象: 指针所指定的活动对象。
zh.尾后一位指针: 可作为数组边界标记、但不可解引用的指针。
zh.行指针: 所指类型为整行数组的指针。
zh.空字符终止符: 标记 C 字符串结束的零字符。
zh.容量: 目的缓冲区可用的总字节数。
zh.结束指针: 转换返回的、指向第一个未消费字符的指针。
zh.成员: 结构体或联合体中的命名组成部分。
zh.填充: 实现为满足布局要求而插入的存储字节。
zh.带标签联合体: 共享成员存储配上说明预期表示的标签。
zh.流: C 库管理缓冲输入输出的对象。
zh.文件结束指示: 区别于全部 unsigned char 值的特殊输入结果。
zh.完整元素: fread 或 fwrite 请求大小所定义的一个完整元素。
zh.所有者: 负责恰好释放一次分配的代码。
zh.借用者: 在对象生命周期与契约有效时获准使用对象的代码。
zh.悬空指针: 关联到生命周期已结束对象的指针。
zh.头链接: 指向首节点或 NULL 的指针变量。
zh.链接调整: 在已知位置改变固定数量链接，以插入或删除节点。
zh.二级指针: 用于访问并更新另一指针变量的指针。
zh.回调: 作为行为传给另一操作并由其调用的函数。
zh.函数指针: 用于指定并调用兼容函数的有类型指针。
zh.比较器: 按顺序关系返回负、零或正的回调。
zh.宏展开: 普通 C 类型检查之前的预处理记号替换。
zh.翻译单元: 源文件及其包含文本经过预处理后形成的源代码。
zh.多次求值: 实参记号被复制，导致表达式求值多次。
zh.声明: 向编译器介绍标识符及类型的语句。
zh.定义: 同时提供对象或函数实现的声明。
zh.链接属性: 决定跨作用域或翻译单元的声明是否代表同一实体的规则。
zh.信号处理器: 捕获信号被递送时进入的函数。
zh.信号屏蔽集: 当前被阻止递送的信号集合。
zh.异步信号安全: 即使打断了正在执行的操作，信号契约仍允许的行为。
zh.进程: 拥有地址空间与操作系统资源的执行上下文。
zh.fork 返回值: 子进程中为零，父进程中为子 PID，失败为负一。
zh.写时复制: 在保留普通内存独立语义时延迟物理复制的实现技术。
zh.程序映像: 成功 exec 替换的代码与普通数据。
zh.回收子状态: 通过等待操作收集已终止子进程状态。
zh.编码状态: 必须通过宏解释、不能直接当退出码的等待结果。
zh.端点: 用于管道读端或写端的描述符。
zh.分帧: 从字节流重建记录的应用规则。
zh.部分传输: 成功传输的字节少于请求字节。
zh.消息类型: System V 队列用于分类或选择消息的正 long 值。
zh.数据报: 边界由传输机制保留的有界消息。
zh.套接字对: 同时创建、彼此连接的两个本地通信端点。
zh.共享段: 多个进程附加到同一底层字节的存储。
zh.许可: 成功信号量等待所消耗的一单位可用性。
zh.静止边界: 没有参与者持有尚未完成预留或更新的时刻。
zh.线程启动函数: pthread_create 使用的 void *worker(void *) 形式函数。
zh.汇合等待: 等待可汇合线程结束并收集其结果的操作。
zh.所有权转移: 明确改变最终负责释放对象的代码。
zh.数据竞争: 跨线程未被所需顺序约束的冲突访问，至少一次不是原子访问。
zh.临界区: 持有保护不变式的锁时执行的代码区域。
zh.原子事务: 其他参与者不能观察到中途状态的完整逻辑操作。
zh.可重入性: 在所述契约下再次进入操作，不破坏隐藏未完成状态的能力。
zh.读写锁: 允许多个读取者或一个独占写入者的锁。
zh.快照: 受保护访问结束后仍有明确生命周期的独立副本。
zh.等待条件: 决定是否允许进展的持久共享事实。
zh.伪唤醒: 等待返回，却不证明条件为真的情况。
zh.广播唤醒: 让全部当前等待者有机会恢复并重新检查的通知。
zh.循环等待: 每个参与者等待另一个、最终回到起点的依赖链。
zh.锁等级: 用于一致获取多个锁的稳定排序键。
zh.活锁: 持续活动却无法完成有用工作的情况。
zh.加速比: 同等工作下串行经过时间除以并行经过时间。
zh.额外开销: 由协调、调度或数据移动引入，而非原有有用任务的工作。
zh.划分: 把工作分成边界明确、归属清楚的子问题。
zh.归约: 用指定操作与组合顺序合并局部结果。
zh.前缀扫描: 计算直到每个输入位置的累计结果。
zh.最小复现: 保留暴露故障所需条件的小案例。
zh.故障注入: 有意让选定操作失败，以测试恢复契约。
zh.回归检查: 保留的检查，用于发现已理解缺陷重新出现。
